"""One-off audit command. Reconstruct observations only; never execute a driver."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import mujoco
import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('AA1').resolve()))
from autoadapter_bench.a4_observations import A4Observations
from autoadapter_bench.capability_metrics import evaluate_b1_contract, describe_contract_measurements

base = Path('AA1/autoadapter_bench')
diag = base / 'diagnostics/capability_update_20260909'
run_roots = [diag / name for name in (
    'stage1_full_opus48_20260910T120531Z', 'stage1_full_opus48_20260910T133740Z')]
items = []
for run in run_roots:
    for p in sorted(run.glob('*/*/capability_validation/*a4*/result.json')):
        items.append((p.parents[2].name, 'generated', p))
for rid in ('so101', 'piper', 'franka', 'kuka_iiwa14', 'ufactory_xarm7',
            'kinova_gen3_robotiq_2f85', 'universal_robots_ur5e_robotiq_2f85'):
    for p in sorted((base / f'diagnostics/capability_calibration/{rid}/framework_reference').glob('*a4*/result.json')):
        items.append((rid, 'reference', p))
for p in sorted((diag / 'repair3_opus48_20260910/repair_2/piper/capability_validation').glob('*a4*/result.json')):
    items.append(('piper', 'preserved_generated', p))

out = Path(sys.argv[1])
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
records = []
for rid, origin, result_path in items:
    old_result = json.loads(result_path.read_text())
    met = json.loads(result_path.with_name('metrics.json').read_text())
    evidence = json.loads(result_path.with_name('trace.json').read_text())['evidence']
    suite = json.loads((base / f'spec/capabilities/{rid}/capability_validation_suite.json').read_text())
    case = next(c for c in suite['cases'] if c['case_id'] == result_path.parent.name)
    model_path = Path('AA1') / json.loads((base / f'spec/capabilities/{rid}/capability_design.json').read_text())['scene_path']
    model = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path(str(model_path))
    data = mujoco.MjData(model)
    observer = A4Observations(model, met['parameters'])
    row = {'robot_id': rid, 'origin': origin, 'original_result': str(result_path),
           'original_trace': str(result_path.with_name('trace.json')),
           'case_id': case['case_id'], 'original_ok': old_result['ok'],
           'original_score': met['score'], 'new_score': None,
           'model_scene': str(model_path), 'physics_steps_executed': 0,
           'surface_observations_reconstructed': False,
           'maximum_pose_reconstruction_error_m': 0.0,
           'contact_reconstruction_matches': True}
    try:
        for sample in evidence['samples']:
            data.qpos[:] = sample['qpos']
            data.qvel[:] = sample['qvel']
            data.ctrl[:] = sample['ctrl']
            data.time = sample['time']
            for body_id in range(model.nbody):
                mocap_id = int(model.body_mocapid[body_id])
                if mocap_id >= 0:
                    name = mujoco.mj_id2name(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, body_id) or f'body_{body_id}'
                    data.mocap_pos[mocap_id] = sample['body_positions'][name]
                    data.mocap_quat[mocap_id] = sample['body_quaternions'][name]
            mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
            for index in range(model.nsite):
                name = mujoco.mj_id2name(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE, index) or f'site_{index}'
                error = float(np.max(np.abs(data.site_xpos[index] - sample['site_positions'][name])))
                row['maximum_pose_reconstruction_error_m'] = max(row['maximum_pose_reconstruction_error_m'], error)
            for index in range(model.nbody):
                name = mujoco.mj_id2name(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, index) or f'body_{index}'
                error = float(np.max(np.abs(data.xpos[index] - sample['body_positions'][name])))
                row['maximum_pose_reconstruction_error_m'] = max(row['maximum_pose_reconstruction_error_m'], error)
            recorded_contacts = {tuple(sorted((c['geom1'], c['geom2']))) for c in sample['contacts']}
            reconstructed_contacts = set()
            for contact in data.contact:
                names = [mujoco.mj_id2name(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_GEOM, int(i)) or f'geom_{int(i)}'
                         for i in (contact.geom1, contact.geom2)]
                reconstructed_contacts.add(tuple(sorted(names)))
            row['contact_reconstruction_matches'] &= recorded_contacts == reconstructed_contacts
            if row['maximum_pose_reconstruction_error_m'] > 1e-9 or not row['contact_reconstruction_matches']:
                raise ValueError('saved derived poses/contacts do not match the recorded qpos timestamp; no mixed-time rescore')
            sample.update(observer.snapshot(data))
        row['surface_observations_reconstructed'] = True
        row['new_score'] = evaluate_b1_contract(met['parameters'], evidence=evidence, request=case['request'])
        row['measurements'] = describe_contract_measurements(met['parameters'], evidence=evidence, request=case['request'])
        row['original_execution_errors'] = [s for s in old_result.get('errors', [])
                                            if not s.startswith('trusted metric contract did not pass')]
        row['new_condition_ok'] = bool(row['new_score'] == 1 and not row['original_execution_errors'])
    except Exception as exc:
        row['rescore_unavailable_reason'] = f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'
    records.append(row)
    print(json.dumps({k: row.get(k) for k in ('robot_id','origin','case_id','original_score','new_score','rescore_unavailable_reason')}), flush=True)

payload = {'audit_kind':'saved_state_reconstruction_and_a4_rescore',
           'created_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
           'code_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
           'model_calls':0, 'physics_steps_executed':0,
           'original_files_modified':False,
           'method':'Restore saved qpos/qvel/ctrl/time and static target mocap poses into scratch MjData. mj_forward only. Require derived body/site positions and contact pairs to match saved samples before computing new velocity observations.',
           'limitations':['Offline rescore is not a new generation or physics run.',
                          'Original candidate execution/video/guard errors remain failures.',
                          'Historical traces whose kinematic timestamps do not match are not rescored.',
                          'No original pipeline outcome or completed repair budget is rewritten.'],
           'analysis_command_source':Path(__file__).read_text(), 'cases':records}
(out/'rescore_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print('WROTE', out/'rescore_results.json', flush=True)
